items.title: Bob Coquille Interview, 1978-11-15
items.q: No, but we had a boy that played the bass horn, like Lombardo has.

ctx.x: Did he ever have a mellophone?

No, but we had a boy that played the bass horn, like Lombardo has. And after four hour rehearsals two or three times a week, one year later, it really sounded great. We really, then we began getting jobs on a West End roof, and spot jobs. We all had things to do in a day, so we couldn't take steady work. We were a bunch of kids. And it really sounded good. It's just that after three years, I was ready to make a move to play a different type of music. With all due respect to the Lombardo type of music, I loved it,…
